text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisia celebrates 41st anniversary of army. President Ben Ali to chair military parade.
- President chairs cabinet meeting on strategy to boost exports.
- President instructs Prime Minister Karoui to chair meeting on June 28 with heads of public firms aimed at improving management.
- Office des Tunisiens a l'Etranger issues practical guide for Tunisians living abroad and expected to return home for summer holidays.
- Arab and African newspaper editors meet in Tunis to set up union.
- Summer time for public administrations set from 0730 local time (0630 GMT) to 1330 (1230 GMT) from July 1 to August 30.
